transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I just didn’t wake up. Lately I’ve been saying I don’t need to see another winter.
Have you made any specific plan for how you might end your life, or taken any steps toward doing so?
I haven’t made a plan or taken any steps. It’s more that I keep thinking they’d be better off if I just didn’t wake up… and I don’t feel like I need to see another winter.
Have you ever had a period—lasting several days or more—where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or irritable, needed much less sleep than usual, and felt like your thoughts were racing?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Have you experienced anything like hearing voices or sounds that others don't hear, or having beliefs that others tell you aren't true, during this time?
Some evenings, I hear his voice—plain as day—from the hallway or the spare room. He tells me I should have been there, that I failed him. My wife says the house is quiet, but I hear it.
Do you hear that voice only during times when you're feeling very down and depressed, or does it also happen even when your mood feels more like your usual self?
Only when I’ve been this low. Before my friend died, I never heard his voice or thought I was being punished. When I felt like myself, none of that happened.
How long have you been feeling this way—down, hopeless, and hearing his voice—has it been going on for two weeks or more?
Yes. It started when my bowling partner died—about a year and a month ago now.
Over this past year, have you noticed changes in your sleep or appetite—such as sleeping much more or less than usual, or a significant change in your appetite or weight?
I'm not really sure. I haven't paid much attention to my eating or sleeping, to be honest.
Over this past year, has your low mood been constant the whole time, or have there been stretches—days or weeks—where you felt back to your normal self before returning to feeling this way?
I’m not sure, doctor. It’s all sort of run together for me.

Before your bowling partner passed away about a year ago, had you ever gone through a separate period in your life—weeks or months—where you felt similarly down, hopeless, or lost interest in things, with a return to your normal self afterward?
I can’t really say, doctor. I don’t remember going through a separate time like that before he died.
